text: Monster Beverage Corporation's subsidiaries develop and market energy drinks, including Monster Energy drinks. The Coca-Cola Company owned approximately 20.9% of Monster Beverage's common stock as of February 13, 2026.
short: Monster Energy is made by Monster Beverage Corporation; Coca-Cola owns about 20.9%.
